//: Codex's half of the hook registration. The SCRIPTS are canonical in .claude/hooks/ and are not copied here — the same arrangement .agents/skills uses for the skills, and for the same reason: a second copy drifts, and this file's did. It pointed at C:\Users\GGPC\... on one developer's machine, so it registered nothing anywhere else, and the copy it pointed at was gated on CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE, which Codex never sets.
//path: Codex sets no CODEX_PROJECT_DIR and runs hooks with the session cwd, which may be a subdirectory. Shell expansion works, so the git root is the one anchor that is correct from anywhere and on both platforms.
//matcher: apply_patch is the tool_name Codex actually sends for a file write; Edit and Write are accepted aliases. Matching all three keeps this readable next to .claude/settings.json.
